data.current_description: Move a phone number from one org to another. Billing anchor clamp (TENANT-04, tightened): ``billing_next_charge_at`` is a per-number monthly billing anchor consumed by the ``charge_phone_numbers`` management command (see ``billing.services.charge_phone_number_monthly``), which charges a number's *current* organization once ``billing_next_charge_at`` has passed and then advances the anchor by another month. The original TENANT-04 ruling had a cross-org transfer unconditionally reset the anchor to "transfer time + 1 month", so the target org always started a fresh monthly cycle at the moment of transfer. That ruling is superseded: it opened a billing "ping-pong" loophole, since every transfer pushed the anchor a full month out -- bouncing a number between two orgs more often than monthly slid the anchor forever and the monthly fee was never charged. The current rule clamps the anchor instead of resetting it, so a transfer can only ever pull the anchor *closer* to now, never push it further out: new_anchor = max(now, min(existing_anchor, now + 1 month)) (existing_anchor is None) -> now + 1 month Effects: - A genuine transfer of a number with an anchor already due soon (or any time within the next month) keeps that existing charge schedule -- whoever holds the number when the fee comes due pays it, so total fees are unchanged for same-owner reorgs. This is intentionally *not* prorated: the source org is not refunded for the unused remainder of its last charged cycle, and the target is not charged immediately upon transfer. - An overdue anchor (in the past, e.g. the reconciliation command just hasn't run yet) clamps to "now", so the new holder is charged at the next reconciliation instead of inheriting an ever-sliding future date. - A number with no billing history (``billing_next_charge_at`` is None) has no existing anchor to clamp, so it falls back to "now + 1 month", same as the original ruling's fresh-cycle behavior. - Ping-pong transfers gain nothing: the clamp can only move the anchor earlier or leave it unchanged, never later, so hopping a number between orgs cannot delay the charge indefinitely.
data.summary_suggestion: Transfer phone number to another organization
data.description_suggestion: Transfers a phone number from the current organization to a target organization. Requires PhoneNumberTransferRequestRequest with the target organization details. The billing cycle anchor is preserved using a clamping mechanism: the new anchor is max(now, min(existing_anchor, now + 1 month)), preventing billing manipulation through repeated transfers. Returns the updated phone number object with new organization assignment. Side effects: active calls may be affected, and billing responsibility transfers to the target organization. Non-prorated: source org is not refunded for unused cycle time.
